execution_gate: Implement only after core-feature-ownership-full-closure is implemented/certified and its final ownership census/core-admission ratchets are present on main.
project_description: Complete provider-facing prompt-cache locality hinting without regrowing generic core. The revised post-core-closure architecture moves HMAC derivation, fill-only synthesis policy and telemetry into a standard downstreamcacheaffinity feature, composes it through standardplugins/featurehost, reuses the existing candidate-aware PlaneAttemptTransforms seam, and permits only bounded generic immutable backend-feature metadata if the final post-closure tree still lacks an equivalent carrier. It explicitly forbids a cache-specific core package, executor/security-runtime/process-services fields, execbackend resolver, core metrics callback or new feature plane. The SDD retains direct OpenAI Responses prompt_cache_key repair, the non-lossy provider-profile lifecycle repair/reuse, typed profile projection, frozen xAI/Mistral/Fireworks/RunInfra/OpenRouter matrix, executable connector negotiation without new protobuf value fields/minor, and strict separation from session authority, continuation and prompt-cache residency/keep-warm. Because no production wire compatibility exists yet, the generated value starts with the planned AIProxer branding: aipca1_ plus a full SHA-256 raw-base64url digest (50 chars), with aiproxer/... HMAC domains. Tasks are execution-grade for a weaker instruction-following model and include a hard RED gate proving no later PCK writer invalidates use of the existing attempt-transform seam.
